title: HDFC Top 100 Fund - Monthly Scheme Factsheet

sections.content: HDFC Top 100 Fund is an open-ended equity scheme investing predominantly in large cap stocks. As of October 2026, total Scheme AUM is ₹37,293.95 Crore. Direct Plan Growth NAV is ₹1,133.761. The fund is managed by Rahul Baijal (Senior Vice President, managing since July 2022).

Total Expense Ratio (TER) for Direct Plan is 1.02% per annum. Exit load is 1.00% if redeemed within 1 year from the date of allotment. Nil exit load after 365 days. Benchmark index is NIFTY 100 Total Return Index (TRI).

Asset Allocation: Large Cap equities 88.50%, Mid Cap equities 8.20%, Cash & Equivalents 3.30%. Top 5 portfolio holdings: ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Infosys, Larsen & Toubro, and Reliance Industries. Riskometer classification: Very High Risk.
